purpose: Authoritative preimplementation contract. Guest declarations describe rich local resources; schemas describe serialized wire values. Explicit codecs are prescribed in D02, not implemented here.

invariants: Only active control with current epoch may admit a new effect.

Checkpoint publication, paused, completed and cancelled require confirmed input quiescence. Lost/failed/interrupted can report quiescent:false until the independent supervisor confirms cleanup; they never admit more input.
Control expired forbids admission but does not by itself confirm physical quiescence.
Checkpoint answer accepted at most once; exact duplicate attaches; changed duplicate conflicts.
Possible submission never permits automatic effect retry.
A lost guest does not replay a prefix to restore its heap.
